stage: Phase 2 mixed insert-delete to rebuild refresh
refresh_semantics: Delete a seed-991 subset of the original 100K base, insert the same number of previously excluded vectors, retain cardinality 100K, and rebuild from the refreshed snapshot.
reuse_policy: Reuse the existing hash-audited fixed-5-percent refreshed memberships and ten target indexes; do not reuse any prior result label or prior evaluation query for the Recall@10=.95 analysis.

index.implementation: official DARTH Faiss HNSW fork for native graph search replay

external_methods: No Phase-1 external adaptive method passed the registered source-to-target safety integration gate; DARTH and Ada-ef are therefore retained as Phase-1 evidence and are not forced into Phase 2.
role_firewall: Selection may define the registered target recalibration comparator. Certification alone determines accept or fallback. Cold evaluation cannot alter actions, thresholds, fallback, or reporting rules. All new roles are content-disjoint from base, insert reserve, and every historical query role.
certification: Per target build and deployable action, use a one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the 500-query certification role; accept only when UCB <= .05, otherwise deploy the independently certified fixed-safe endpoint.

report: mean, p95, and p99 distance computations
truth, selection, certification, rebuild, and serving cost

primary_gate.safety: Both datasets have evaluation risk <= .05 and every deployed build has certification UCB <= .05.
primary_gate.efficiency: Mean distance-computation gain versus the certified fixed-safe endpoint is at least 5% with target-build bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.
primary_gate.tail: Both datasets have p95 no worse than fixed-safe; p99 and fallback tails are reported without substitution.
primary_gate.robustness: Direction survives LOBO and deletion of the largest-benefit build.
primary_gate.transfer: Rebuild-only, refresh-plus-rebuild, and target-recalibration effects remain separately identifiable.

claim_policy: A safe positive result on only one dataset is conditional value, not universal superiority. Failure of mean or tail gain does not erase a valid safety audit result. TCP remains conditional unless all registered safety, tail, and lifecycle-cost gates close.
stop_rules: Stop on input-hash drift, query-content overlap, native-action mismatch, missing exact truth, or non-replay of the fixed 5% refresh membership.
Stop before new builds if free data500 space is below projected additions plus 5 GiB.
Do not access validation-dev, formal-test, or any sealed evaluation role from earlier stages.
Do not tune the action grid, alpha, risk threshold, target, fallback, or method after Recall@10=.95 results are observed.
